## Checklist

- [ ] The change matches its pull request in `docs/plan.html`, or the description says why it differs.
- [ ] `pnpm fmt:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass.
- [ ] UI changes have simulator proof from the scripts in `scripts/sim/`.
- [ ] Native settings changed only in `apps/mobile/app.config.ts`. Nothing under `apps/mobile/ios/` is committed.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, real names, email addresses, tokens, `research/screenshots/` or real Hevy exports.
- [ ] Reviewed with the sol loop, then the council. Both council scores are 9 or higher.
